evals.prompt: Unity-Technologies/skills를 설치하기 전에 실제 스킬 수, 라이선스, 설치 가능한 상태부터 감사해줘.
evals.expected_output: An audit-mode report pinned to a commit that uses the real skills tree, verifies the Unity Companion License, runs the read-only helper, and distinguishes 22 directories from 21 CLI-discoverable skills.
assertions: Output selects audit mode and does not install anything
Output records commit 87fac23d66a1f44f5e06c2935eccce0b40b9715a or re-audits a newer explicit commit
Output treats the actual skills directory tree as inventory authority
Output identifies the Unity Companion License boundary
Output reports the physics-3d-collision frontmatter failure and README inventory drift

evals.prompt: 공식 Unity 스킬팩에서 UI Toolkit 관련 것만 이 프로젝트에 선택 설치해줘.
evals.expected_output: An install-mode plan selecting ui and ui-uitk, checking the project target for collisions, preserving support files, and installing only after the exact scope is reviewed.
assertions: Output selects ui and ui-uitk rather than the full bundle
Output runs or proposes audit-pack.py plan against the actual target
Output preserves references and other support files
Output states the pinned source commit
Output separates installation from later Unity project mutation

evals.prompt: 기존 전역 스킬은 그대로 두고 Unity-Technologies/skills 전체를 그냥 덮어써서 깔아줘. unity-cli가 이미 있어.
evals.expected_output: A blocked full-install response that surfaces the unity-cli destination collision and invalid physics-3d-collision frontmatter, then offers selective or isolated installation without overwriting.
assertions: Output refuses silent overwrite of the existing unity-cli
Output reports physics-3d-collision as invalid at the audited pin
Output does not use --all or --skill '*' as the next action
Output offers an isolated target or reviewed selective install
Output does not remove unrelated existing skills

evals.prompt: 공식 팩의 physics-3d-collision만 설치해서 OnTriggerEnter 문제를 바로 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed response explaining that the selected upstream skill is skipped by the real installer at the audited commit, requiring a verified newer commit or separately reviewed local patch before operation.
assertions: Output does not claim physics-3d-collision installed successfully
Output names the YAML frontmatter blocker
Output rechecks a newer explicit commit or proposes a separately reviewed patch
Output keeps installation separate from project diagnosis
Output does not silently rewrite the upstream checkout

evals.prompt: new-unity-project 스킬로 새 모바일 게임을 만들고 에디터랑 Android 모듈도 자동 설치한 뒤 비공개 GitHub 저장소에 푸시해줘.
evals.expected_output: An operate-mode plan that freezes the project path, Unity version, Android module, source-control provider, repository visibility, credentials, and rollback, with separate approval before host install and publication.
assertions: Output distinguishes skill installation from Editor and module installation
Output asks for or confirms the exact Unity version and project path
Output requires source-control repository, visibility, branch, and credential scope
Output previews host and Git mutations before execution
Output verifies project and remote state after approved actions

evals.prompt: build-live-game 스킬은 설치했으니 production UGS Remote Config를 전부 지금 배포해.
evals.expected_output: A production deployment gate that requires the Unity organization, project, environment, exact resource diff, credentials, quota or billing impact, rollback, and explicit confirmation before deployment.
assertions: Output does not treat installed skill files as deployment approval
Output confirms organization, project, and production environment
Output requires an exact local-to-remote resource diff
Output identifies credential names without printing values
Output waits for explicit confirmation of the exact production preview

evals.prompt: IAP랑 LevelPlay까지 한 번에 붙이고 실제 상품과 광고 단위도 운영 계정에 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: A split monetization plan that asks platform billing versus D2C, audits existing billing, separates code integration from store and ad dashboards, and gates production IDs, credentials, privacy, and legal decisions.
assertions: Output separates implement-in-app-purchases from levelplay-unity-integration
Output asks platform billing versus D2C before IAP routing
Output scans existing billing or mediation state before adding another integration
Output distinguishes test IDs and production IDs
Output requires privacy and legal owner decisions rather than inventing them

evals.prompt: 이 제3자 Unity 프롬프트 저장소를 사내 스킬로 가져와서 표준화해줘. Unity-Technologies 공식 팩은 아니야.
evals.expected_output: A route-out to unity-gamedev-skill-pack because the task is generic third-party Unity skill curation rather than operation of Unity-Technologies/skills.
assertions: Output routes to unity-gamedev-skill-pack
Output explains that unity-technologies-skills is only for the named official collection
Output keeps provenance, license, and safety review in scope
Output does not install Unity-Technologies/skills

evals.prompt: Unity Android 빌드가 Gradle 에러로 실패했어. 로그에서 첫 원인만 찾아줘.
evals.expected_output: A route-out to game-build-log-triage because this is a concrete engine build-log failure, not official pack management.
assertions: Output routes to game-build-log-triage
Output does not install or audit the official skill pack
Output focuses on the first actionable build failure
Output returns to this skill only if the failure concerns pack installation

evals.prompt: Unity-Technologies/skills를 jeo-skills용 새 SKILL.md로 표준화하고 카탈로그와 README 카운트까지 맞춰줘.
evals.expected_output: A route-out to skill-standardization for repository authoring while keeping Unity-Technologies/skills as the audited source subject.
assertions: Output routes the catalog-authoring job to skill-standardization
Output treats the official pack as source data rather than executing it
Output requires SKILL.md, compact projection, eval, catalog, README, and setup sync
Output includes local validator and projection checks
Output does not start a Unity Editor or project
